title: Decision record
description: The router's record of one routing round, as the deployment's statement in the envelope (REQ-AUD-4, REQ-QTE-16, REQ-PRT-1). The statement holds the request, the catalogue snapshot and the policy bounds verbatim, with the objective, every figure's age and origin and every provider and policy version they hold; the router's version; every candidate and why each was dropped; and the chosen one: never in a shortlist round, whose kept candidates are the shortlist, and absent in a choice round with no route. Routing the statement's own request, snapshot and bounds again gives the same statement, with no provider call (AC-2). Its id is its request's. The router returns the statement; the deployment signs it when it records it. Every operation cites a tuple of its own provider with its two ends; the choice round chooses only a confirmed candidate; a drop reason that names a figure names one its candidate cites, which supports the drop. These and other rules a schema can't express are checked by the contract's Rust types; see the contract's README.

ranking.description: What the ranking compared (REQ-QTE-11, REQ-AUD-4): before_operator_fee, the providers' amounts and declared times before the operator's fee in the bounds. Ranking net of that fee would be a new value.

candidates.description: Every candidate considered, each with an id unique in the record.

chosen.description: The chosen candidate, by id: in a choice round, the only one without a drop reason. Its parts are the chosen split. Never in a shortlist round; absent in a choice round with no route.
